name: Delonghi Pinguino N Series 13,000 BTU Portable Air Conditioner with Heat Pump and Remote - PACN130HPE
description: The DeLonghi Pinguino N Series 13,000 BTU air-to-air portable air conditioner with heat pump offers cooling and supplemental heating comfort for rooms up to 500 square feet. Use it all year round! The easy-to-use Electronic Climate Control (ECC) panel includes a 24-hour digital timer and digital thermostat. The intelligent remote control allows you to operate the ECC from across the room. The exclusive Condensate Recirculation system recycles the condensation within the machine for dripless, bucketless operation. Additional features include quiet mode, separate dehumidifying function, separate fan function and eco-friendly R410A refrigerant. This unit is easily portable with durable castor wheels and side-carry handles so you can use it where you need it, when you need it. The easy 5-minute set up requires no tools (window bracket and exhaust hose are included). Pinguino N series 13,000 BTU 115-volt air-to-air portable air conditioner with 3810-watt heat pump Up to 500 square feet of cooling 3810 watts of supplemental heating power Fan-only function R410A refrigerant Quiet mode to ensure maximum quietness Exclusive condensate recirculation system recycles the condensation within the machine for dripless, bucketless operation Dehumidification while cooling removes up to 54.95 pints of excess moisture per day Separate dehumidifying only function removes up to 86.65 pints of excess moisture per day Electronic Climate Control (ECC) panel with digital thermostat Intelligent remote control operates the ECC from across the room 3 fan speeds and auto fan function 24-hour digital timer Easy access washable air filter Easily portable with durable caster wheels and side-carry handles Easy 5-minute set up requires no tools (window bracket and exhaust hose are included) Color: Black

name: KwiKool KWIB2411 Commercial 23,500 BTU Commercial 120 Volt Water Cool Portable A
description: Keep the entire office building, restaurant or home cool during the summer months when you use the KwiKool Commercial 23,500 BTU Commercial 120 Volt Water Cool Portable AC (KWIB2411). This water-cooled portable AC features 23,500 BTU of cooling power, allowing an extreme amount of cooling power that can cool mid-size to large rooms in any home, building, restaurant, and more. The direct drive fan enables the fan-forced cooling to create cool air around the room that flows evenly and freely. Allowing you to regulate the flow of air, the built-in digital thermostat also enables you to adjust and maintain the temperature of the air, which is great for cooling entire rooms in a comfortable temperature that everyone will love. To make cooling much easier, four (4) rolling casters allow you to move the portable air conditioner from room-to-room, while the 6 foot power cord gives you enough length away from the outlet to increase the cooling range. Ideal for commercial applications, this portable air conditioner will be a great addition to restaurants, office buildings, and more to meet their grueling cooling needs. Auto Restart: The auto restart function gives the air conditioner a safety feature that enables the unit to turn back on after a power outage, which can keep the AC from breaking Digital Thermostat: A built-in digital thermostat allows you to easily adjust and maintain the temperature of the air that the air conditioner emits Portability: Four (4) rolling casters allow you to move this portable AC from room-to-room, giving you easy cooling wherever you need it Note: Tap water is not appropriate for this model. A circulating water system is required.
